detailed_findings.finding: The algebraic reduction from the quotient of Gaussian q-binomial coefficients to a ratio of q-Pochhammer symbols is correct.
The factorizations of (q;q)_b and (q;q)_{r+b}, including the reindexing j = r + i, are valid under a <= b.
The proof explicitly handles the empty-product case a = b, so the identity is complete for all permitted parameters.

reason: The proof matches the stated lemma and cleanly derives the quotient formula by expanding the Gaussian q-binomial definitions, substituting n-a=r+b and n-b=r+a, factoring the relevant q-Pochhammer symbols, reindexing the tail product, and cancelling common factors. The hypotheses 0 <= a <= b and a+b <= n are used exactly to ensure all q-Pochhammer indices are nonnegative and the interval products are well-formed. No forbidden or undeclared dependencies are used.
